title: Italian Air Force chief introduces Malmgren's book

tellings.quote: one of the people introducing the book was the chief of the Italian air force

plain: In Italy in 2025, the head of the Italian Air Force was one of the people who presented a book written by Harold Malmgren, a former advisor to US presidents who says he handled UFO material directly. Malmgren tells this himself, as a sign that senior military figures took his work seriously.
